lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 14 distinct white vertical stripes visible on the torso; spacing is approximately uniform across the mid-section with narrowing intervals observed toward the anterior shoulder region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One Y-shaped bifurcation observed on the dorsal portion of the 5th vertical stripe from the anterior; one subtle merging of lines on the upper flank of the 10th stripe.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Stripe 1 and 2 exhibit truncation before the mid-lateral line; stripes 12 and 13 show fading and discontinuity near the ventral margin.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 4 high-contrast white spots is visible on the posterior flank, situated just above the junction of the hind limb and the torso.

other_distinctive_markers: Three distinct white spots are visible on the lateral face (cheek area); a white chevron is present across the bridge of the muzzle; black-pigmented patches are visible on the distal ends of the lower limbs.
